children: Brightline Interactive reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $320K and a net loss of $16.64M, reflecting a steep decline in sales and wider losses versus the prior year as the company restructured and refocused its business — 10-K Summary.
Revenue was $320K for FY 2026, down from $5.27M in FY 2025; YoY change (94%).
Net income was a loss of $16.64M for FY 2026, compared with a net loss of $2.55M in FY 2025.
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported for total diluted EPS in disclosed sections.
Revenue fell roughly 95% year over year, driven by delays to a DOW contract and the winddown of legacy VR/AR businesses.
In June 2026 the company transformed into a single-entity tech company centered on Brightline Interactive and SpatialCore.
Management divested or wound down non-core subsidiaries and restructured remaining entities into Brightline Interactive to focus on core capabilities.
R&D investment rose 112% as headcount costs shifted from project COGS to platform development for the company’s Physical AI efforts.
Corporate moves included a 1-for-8 reverse stock split and securing a $1.25M sale and purchase agreement to support operations and Nasdaq compliance.
